original: tattvapratipādanānantaraṃ pratipakṣabhāvanā tadavasthā phalaprāptiś ca vaktavyāḥ |
tattvānantaram uddiṣṭatvāt pratipakṣabhāvanāpratibaddhatvāc ca tadavasthāphalaprāptyor uddeśaḥ |
sūtre pratipakṣatvena bodhipakṣyā abhipretā iti pradarśayann āha: pratipakṣabhāvanā bodhipakṣyabhāvaneti |
te hi yathoktāvaraṇavipakṣaprahāṇāya bhāvyamānāḥ prabhavantīti pratipakṣā ucyante |
te punaḥ saptatriṃśat catvāri smṛtyupasthānāni yāvad āryāṣṭāṅgo mārgaḥ |
teṣāṃ bhāvanā bṛṃhaṇāropaṇābhyāsaḥ bahulīkriyā iti paryāyāḥ |
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ smṛtyupasthānabhāvanaiva pūrvam ucyate nānyā bodhipakṣabhāvanā? āha: tatra tāvad ādau dauṣṭhulyāt tarṣahetutvād iti vistaraḥ |
ādau tāvat smṛtyupasthānabhāvanocyate, paścād anyeṣām apīti |
nirvāṇasaṃsārayor guṇadoṣānavabodhāt saṃskāreṣu sukhaśucinityātmābhiniveśena bālānāṃ bhavabhogeṣu abhinandanaṃ nirvāṇāc cotrāsaḥ |
sa ca guṇadoṣānavabodhaḥ sukhādyabhiniveśaś ca satyadarśanād vinivartata ity ataḥ saṃsārād udvejanārthaṃ nirvāṇe cābhimukhīkaraṇārthaṃ catuḥsatyāvatārāya smṛtyupasthānabhāvanā |
kāyena hi dauṣṭhulyaṃ prabhāvyata iti dauṣṭhulyaṃ duḥsthitatā |
tathā hi pratidinam abhisaṃskriyamāṇo vikriyata eva kāya iti kāyena dauṣṭhulyaṃ prabhāvyate |
yasmād duḥkhasatyasya sadauṣṭhulyāḥ saṃskārā lakṣaṇaṃ svabhāvaḥ kāyena ca dauṣṭhulyaṃ prabhāvyate, tasmāt kāyaparīkṣayā duḥkhasatyam avatarati |
dauṣṭhulyaṃ na vijñāyata ity ata āha: dauṣṭhulyaṃ hi saṃskāraduḥkhateti |
anartho janmedaṃ sati hi janane santi ripavo jarāmṛtyuvyādhivyasanavadhabandhaprabhṛtayaḥ |
anarthās te na syur yadi bahubhayotpattir api na yathājāte vṛkṣe na hi pavanavahnyor vipatanam |
tayeti saṃskāraduḥkhatayā na vipariṇāmaduḥkhatāduḥkhaduḥkhatābhyāṃ, tayor avyāpitvāt saṃskāraduḥkhatānimittatvāc ca |
sarvaṃ sāsravaṃ vastv āryā duḥkhataḥ paśyanti, nānāsravaṃ mārgasatyasya janmotpattipratipakṣatvāt |
sūtre 'py uktaṃ: samāsataḥ pañcopādānaskandhā duḥkham iti |
kiṃ kāraṇam? akarmaṇyatā sāsravatvād avaśyaṃ sāsravā bījahetukābhyupagantavyā |
sā tv abījāpy arhatsantāne kadācid āhārādyapacārād bhavati |
na cāsau dauṣṭhulyaṃ bhavitum arhaty anāsravatvād iti |
tasmāt sukhādyavasthāsahitena kāyena pratikṣaṇabhāvinā tad dauṣṭhulyaṃ prabhāvyate, pratīyata ity arthaḥ |
atra kāraṇam āha: tasya sadauṣṭhulyasaṃskāralakṣaṇatvād iti sabījasaṃskārātmakatvād ity arthaḥ |
saṃskāraduḥkhatā hi vipariṇāmaduḥkhatāduḥkhaduḥkhatādauṣṭhulyābhyām anugatatvāt tatkāraṇatvāc ca dauṣṭhulyam ity uktā |
ata eva saṃskāraduḥkhatayā sarvaṃ sāsravaṃ vastv āryā duḥkhataḥ paśyanti |
tṛṣṇāhetur vedanā, avidyāsaṃsparśajety abhiprāyād, anāsravāyā ataddhetutvāt |
aduḥkhāsukhā tadavasthābhiratitṛṣṇāyās tatsaṃyogāviyogatṛṣṇāyāś ca kasyāṃcit samāpattau hetur iti |
sa duḥkhavedanayā spṛṣṭaḥ kāmasukham abhinandatīti vacanāt, duḥkhāpi vedanā sukhatṛṣṇāyā hetur bhavati |
sa hi vedanāṃ svarūpataḥ kāraṇato 'nityato duḥkhataś copaparīkṣamāṇaḥ samudayasatyam avatarati |
tṛṣṇā hi sūtre samudayasatyam ity uktā |
ko duḥkhasamudayaḥ? tṛṣṇā paunarbhavikī nandī rāgasahagate ti vistaraḥ |
citte hy anityatvādiparīkṣayātmābhiniveśo vyāvartate duḥkhasaṃjñā pravartate |
teṣāṃ sāṃkleśikānāṃ vyāvadānikānāṃ ca vipakṣapratipakṣabhāvaṃ buddhvā sarvopadravātyantaprahāṇopāye mārgasatye abhimukhībhavati |

tatra kāyasmṛtyupasthānabhāvanā anityato duḥkhataḥ śūnyato 'nātmato 'py anekāśucidravyasvabhāvato 'py aśucibījato 'py aśuciniṣyandato 'pi aśucisthitihetuto 'py aśucivikārato 'pi phenapiṇḍavadasārato 'pi gatito 'pi yonito 'pi |

vedanācittadharmasmṛtyupasthānabhāvanā punar anityaduḥkhaśūnyānātmato 'pi sāmānyalakṣaṇato 'pi svalakṣaṇato 'pi hetuto 'pi phalato 'pi dhātubhūmigatito 'pi kuśalākuśalāvyākṛtato 'pi vipakṣato 'pi pratipakṣato 'pi |
bodhisattvānāṃ punaḥ smṛtyupasthānabhāvanaivaṃ cānupalambhākāreṇa ca vikalpaprahāṇārtham |
smṛtyupasthānānāṃ tu prajñāsvābhāvye 'pi smṛtyupasthānavacanaṃ smṛtibalenopasthānāt smṛtir vaibhir upatiṣṭhate smṛtyupasthānam iti |
kiṃ kāraṇam? ata āha: yasmāt parijñāte vipakṣe ca iti vistaraḥ |
dhātubhūmiprahāṇasāmānyalakṣaṇādyākārais tathā sāsravānāsravadhātubhūmiśaikṣāśaikṣādibhedena ca vipakṣe pratipakṣe ca sarvaprakāraṃ parijñātevipakṣāpagamāyeti |
pratipakṣopagamāya ceti pratipakṣāgama utpannānāṃ prabandhānuvṛttir anutpannānāṃ cotpādaḥ |
utpannānāṃ pāpakānām akuśalānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ prahāṇāyeti vistara ity anenāgamena vīryasyaiva caturdhā pravṛttiṃ darśayati |
tatrāyaṃ śeṣo granthaḥ: prahāṇāya cchandaṃ janayati vyāyacchate vīryam ārabhate cittaṃ pragṛhṇāti samyak pradadhāti |
evam anutpannānāṃ pāpakānām akuśalānāṃ dharmāṇām anutpādāya chandaṃ janayatīti vistaraḥ |
evam anutpannānāṃ kuśalānāṃ dharmāṇām utpādāya cchandam janayatīti vistaraḥ |
utpannānāṃ kuśalānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ sthitaye bhūyobhāvāya paripūraṇāya cchandaṃ janayati vyāyacchate vīryam ārabhate cittaṃ pragṛhṇāti samyak pradadhāti |
vyāyacchata iti kausīdyaprahāṇāya kāyacitte abhimukhīkarotīty arthaḥ |
katham ārabhate? līnaṃ cittaṃ pragṛhṇāti saṃvejanīyapramodanīyadharmamanaskāraiḥ |
uddhataṃ cittaṃ tasminn evālambane samyak pradadhāti saṃvejanīyapramodanīyadharmamanaskārair dhārayatīty arthaḥ |
evaṃ ca samyakpradhānāni vīryātmakānīti jñāpitaṃ bhavati |
sā ca karmaṇyatā chandavīryacittamīmāṃsādhipatyaprabhavety ata āha: karmaṇyatā catvāra ṛddhipādā iti |
tasyāḥ pratiṣṭhārthena ṛddhipādā ṛddhihetava ity arthaḥ |

te punaś chandasamādhiḥ prahāṇasaṃskārasamanvāgata ṛddhipādaḥ, vīryasamādhiḥ prahāṇasaṃskārasamanvāgata ṛddhipādaḥ, cittasamādhiḥ prahāṇasaṃskārasamanvāgata ṛddhipādaḥ, mīmāṃsāsamādhiḥ prahāṇasaṃskārasamanvāgata ṛddhipāda iti |
tatra cchandasamādhir yadā cchandādhipatyād vīryārambhe satkṛtya pravartamānaḥ spṛśati cittasyaikāgratām |
vīryasamādhir yadā vīryam ārabhamāṇaḥ sātatyaprayogāt spṛśati cittasyaikāgratām |
cittasamādhir yadā pūrvasamādhibījam āgamya citta eva cittaṃ dhārayan spṛśati cittasyaikāgratām |
sthitir atra cittasthitiḥ, samādhir veditavya iti |
yata ārabdhavīryasya cittakarmaṇyatā catvāra ṛddhipādā ataḥ samyakprahāṇānantaram ṛddhipādā nirdiṣṭāḥ |
sā punaḥ karmaṇyatā kiṃprayojanā kiṃhetukā ca? ity ata āha: pañcadoṣaprahāṇāyāṣṭaprahāṇasaṃskārabhāvanānvayā veditavyeti |
te ca pañca doṣā na vijñāyanta ity ataḥ pṛcchati katame: pañca doṣā? iti tān darśayann āha: kausīdyam avavādasya sammoṣo laya uddhataḥ |
ete hi ṣaḍ doṣā ity ata āha: tatra layauddhatyam eko doṣaḥ kriyata iti |
layauddhatyavigamād dhi samatāprāptatvāt praśāntam ity ucyate |
kasya prahāṇāya? anantaroktānāṃ pañcānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ prahāṇāya |
yady evaṃ tena vaktavyam: eṣāṃ prahāṇāyakatham aṣṭau prahāṇasaṃskārā vyavasthāpyanta iti |
tatra chando 'bhilāṣaḥ, vyāyāmo vīryam, śraddhābhisaṃpratyayaḥ, prasrabdhiḥ karmaṇyatā |
kathaṃ punar ete kausīdyaprahāṇāya vyavasthāpyanta? ity ata āha: te punar yathākramaṃ veditavyāḥ |
āśrayo 'thāśritas tasya nimittaṃ phalam eva ca |
ato 'nyonyaprabhāvitatvād ete kausīdyaprahāṇāya saṃvartanta iti darśayati |
katham? ity ato bravīti: saṃpratyaye saty abhilāṣād iti |
katham? ity ata āha: ārabdhavīryasya samādhiviśeṣādhigamād iti |
ata ārabdhavīryasya samādhiviśeṣagamanāt prasrabdhir vyāyāmaphalam ity uktam |
tathā hy ārabdhavīryasya dauṣṭhulyavitarkādyapakṣālavigamāt prītir jāyate |
atra ca vīryaṃ sahetukaṃ saphalaṃ ca kausīdyapratipakṣatvenoktam |
tatra smṛtir avavādasammoṣasya pratipakṣaḥ, saṃprajanyaṃ layauddhatyasya, cetanānabhisaṃskārasya, abhisaṃskārasyopekṣeti saṃskāropekṣātra veditavyā |
smṛtyādīnāṃ punar lakṣaṇavivakṣayedam āha: te punaḥ smṛtyādayoveditavyā yathākramam iti |
smṛtir ālambane 'sampramoṣa iti cittasthityavavādavastv abhilapanam ity arthaḥ |
upasthitasmṛtir hi saṃprajanyavān bhavaty evety ata āha: smṛtyasaṃpramoṣe sati iti |
anubuddhya layauddhatyaṃ śamathavipaśyanābhyāṃ yuganaddhavāhitvāt aprayatnena pravartate ity arthaḥ |
etad uktaṃ bhavati: sūpasthitasmṛtir avavāde līnaṃ cittam uddhataṃ vā yathābhūtaṃ prajānāti |
atra ca karmaṇyatāsthitir iti svārthe bhāvapratyayaḥ khakkhaṭatvādivat |
teṣāṃ kathaṃ vyavasthānam iti kenārthenety abhiprāyaḥ |
ata āha: ropite mokṣabhāgīye cchandayogādhipatyataḥ iti vistaraḥ |
ādhipatyata iti vartata ity anena cchandayogādhipatyata ity atrādhipatyaśabdaḥ prayukta uttaratrāpy anuvartata iti darśayati |
ṛddhipādaiḥ karmaṇyacittasyāropite mokṣabhāgīye kuśalamūla iti, karmaṇyacittasya mokṣabhāgīyaṃ kuśalamūlaṃ cittasantāne pratiṣṭhāṃ pratilabhate |
chandādhipatyato yāvat pravicayādhipatyataḥ, na tv akarmaṇyacittasya |
tasmād ṛddhipādānantaraṃ mokṣabhāgīyakuśalamūlaropaṇādhipatyāc chraddhādīni pañcendriyāṇīti vyavasthāpyante |
chandādhipatyata iti kāraṇe kāryopacārāc chraddhaivātra cchandaśabdenoktā, tadyathā dadhitrapuṣaṃ sadyojvara iti |
atha vāstitvaguṇavattvaśakyatveṣv yathākramam abhisaṃpratyayaḥ prasādo 'bhilāṣaḥ śraddhāyā lakṣaṇam |
ataś cchandagrahaṇenātrābhilāṣalakṣaṇā śraddhaiva gṛhyate na tu cchanda iti |
caśabdena mokṣabhāgīyakuśalamūlaropaṇādhipatyād yathākramaṃ pañcaśraddhādīnīndriyāṇi veditavyānīti darśayati |
śraddadhāno hi saṃsāracārakān niḥsaraṇārthaṃ vīryam ārabhate |
anye tv āhuḥ: na mokṣabhāgīyakuśalamūlaropaṇādhipatyataḥ śraddhādīnām indriyatvam |
kiṃ tarhi ropite mokṣabhāgīye kuśalamūle chandādīnām ādhipatyata etānīndriyāṇīty ucyate? etad eva pradarśayann āha: chandādhipatyataḥ śraddhāyā indriyatvam iti sambadhyate |
teṣāṃ prayogāsammoṣāvisārapravicayānām ādhipatyād vīryasmṛtisamādhiprajñākhyāś caittā indriyākhyā bhavantīti |
atra tv etad vaktavyam: ropite mokṣabhāgīye kuśalamūle ropitāvasthātaś chandādyādhipatyasya śraddhādīnāṃ ca na kaścid ātmātiśayaḥ |
tathā hi tadavasthāyāṃ tadādhipatyāt teṣām indriyatvam avasthāpyata iti |
